name: no-employer-payroll
description: Norway employer payroll for income year 2026: an employer paying wages in Norway. Covers the tax card (skattekort) and the duty to fetch it before each pay run, table versus percentage deduction, the 50% and 30% rates when no card is available, the NOK 100,000 exemption card (frikort), the holiday-pay and pre-Christmas withholding breaks, the 25% PAYE source tax for foreign workers, payment of withheld tax by the first working day after payday (new from 2026, the tax deduction account is gone), the a-melding by the 5th, employer national insurance contributions (arbeidsgiveravgift) by zone, 14.1% to 0%, paid every two months, the zone Ia NOK 850,000 allowance, coercive fines and liability for unpaid withholding. Trigger on: Norway payroll, forskuddstrekk, skattekort, a-melding, arbeidsgiveravgift, frikort, kildeskatt på lønn, employer contributions Norway. Out of scope: income tax bands (no-income-tax) and self-employed contributions (no-social-contributions).
